Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about using Lumenflow, managing your subscription, troubleshooting common issues, and getting help from our support team. Can't find what you're looking for? Jump to the contact section below.

General Use

What is Lumenflow and who is it for?

Lumenflow is a workflow automation platform designed for small and mid-sized teams who need to streamline repetitive tasks, connect their favorite apps, and track project progress from a single dashboard. It's used by marketing, operations, and customer success teams alike.

Do I need any technical skills to use Lumenflow?

No. Lumenflow's drag-and-drop workflow builder is designed for non-technical users. If you want to build advanced custom integrations, we also offer an optional API and webhook system for developers.

Can I use Lumenflow on mobile devices?

Yes. Lumenflow works in any modern mobile browser, and we offer dedicated iOS and Android apps for viewing dashboards, approving tasks, and receiving notifications on the go.

Account & Billing

What plans does Lumenflow offer?

We offer Starter ($19/user/month), Professional ($39/user/month), and Enterprise (custom pricing) plans. Each tier adds more automation runs, integrations, and advanced reporting features. You can compare all plans on our pricing page.

How do I update my payment method or cancel my subscription?

Go to Account Settings > Billing inside the app. From there you can update your card, download past invoices, or cancel your subscription at any time. Cancellations take effect at the end of your current billing cycle.

Is there a free trial available?

Yes, every new account starts with a 14-day free trial of the Professional plan, no credit card required. You'll receive a reminder email three days before the trial ends so you can choose a plan that fits.

Technical Issues

Why is a workflow stuck in "pending" status?

This usually happens when an external app connection has expired. Go to Integrations > Connected Apps and reauthorize the affected app. If the issue persists after reconnecting, contact support with your workflow ID.

Which browsers and integrations does Lumenflow support?

Lumenflow works best on the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. We natively integrate with over 80 apps including Slack, Google Workspace, Salesforce, and Stripe, plus custom connections via our REST API.

I lost access to my two-factor authentication device. What do I do?

Use one of your saved backup codes to sign in, then reconfigure 2FA under Account Settings > Security. If you no longer have your backup codes, contact support to verify your identity and regain access.

Support

What are your support hours and response times?

Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM Central Time. Starter plan customers receive a response within one business day; Professional and Enterprise customers receive priority responses within four hours.

Do you offer onboarding or training for new teams?

Yes. Every Professional and Enterprise account includes a complimentary 45-minute onboarding call, plus access to our video library and live monthly webinars covering advanced workflow strategies.

Still have questions?

Our support team is happy to help with anything not covered above — from billing questions to technical troubleshooting.
